messages.subject: UPDATE: IsoriX 0.9.0 is on CRAN
parts:
Hi all,

I just updated (again) IsoriX!

In the context of the large update stamped version 0.8.3, I had revised completely the calibration procedure to allow for more flexibility (see email from the 13 of September).

In doing so, I had introduced a mistake in how the variance of the assignment test is computed in the absence of calibration.

This is now fixed, sorry about that.

What next?

The next update (0.9.1) will be focussing on weighting isoscape by precipitation amount.
This does not represent much coding, so I do not foresee particular difficulties.

All the best,

Alex
